rule_result.rule: drop failures / RAM >= 15 GB / median seam ratio > 1.5; mean rank on dev of KID, CLIP, BRISQUE, sharpness, boxiness; ties -> faster

override_reason: The pre-fixed rule picks sd21 by 0.2 mean-rank points (1.6 vs 1.8); without the sharpness term it is a tie (1.5 / 1.5) broken by speed. Laplacian sharpness rewards the Real-ESRGAN edge over-sharpening of the 1024x512 source, the artefact the owner named (sharp edges, no real detail). Visual check of dev views at 100 % (results/figures/v5_pano_crops_dev.png): sd21 smeared surfaces; xl_redmond real texture (wood, foliage, window frames, fabric); xl_pgg mostly empty white walls. PLAN_V5 goal: a result that measures well and looks bad is a failure -> xl_redmond adopted; its lower boxiness is addressed by milestone-2 candidate selection; its worse KID vs MMIS is reported as a negative.
